sn48.52:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallakesu viharati uruvelakappaṃ nāma mallakānaṃ nigamo.
sn48.52:1.4: yāva kīvañca bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa ariyaṃ ñāṇaṃ nūppannaṃ hoti neva tāva catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, neva tāva catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa ariyañāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāvakīvañca kūṭāgārassa kūṭaṃ na ussitaṃ hoti, neva tāva gopānasīnaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, neva tāva gopānasīnaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:2.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave, kūṭāgārassa kūṭaṃ ussitaṃ hoti, atha kho gopānasīnaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, atha kho gopānasīnaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:2.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, yāvakīvañca ariyasāvakassa ariyañāṇaṃ na uppannaṃ hoti, neva tāva catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, neva tāva catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:2.4: yato ca kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa ariyañāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ saṇṭhiti hoti, atha catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ avaṭṭhiti hoti.
sn48.52:3.3: paññavato bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa tadanvayā saddhā saṇṭhāti, tadanvayaṃ viriyaṃ saṇṭhāti, tadanvayā sati saṇṭhāti, tadanvayo samādhi saṇṭhātīti.
